senses.def: Used on forms to indicate that the date should be written as two-digit days, months, and years, e.g. 020411 for 2 April 2011
Having dates represented in day-month-year order of two-digit days, months, and years.
A format for dates in the Common Era: 2 digit days, months, and 4 digits for the year. e.g: 1/10/2026
ex: All dates not in DDMMYYYY format were changed to this format.
